in_sanskrit.name: Balaansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Brave, Hero
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balaansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Balaansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bala' meaning strength and 'Ansh' meaning form or symbol. This name is given to a child who is believed to embody the qualities of a brave hero. In Hindu mythology, Balaansh is the name of Lord Shiva's son, who is a symbol of power and courage.
